title: Open Mic @ 511 Bar & Lounge
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring musicians and performers of all genres. 2 drink minimum to perform. Signups start at 7:00 PM.
event_venue_information:
511 Bar & Lounge

Located in the heart of Flagler Village, 511 Bar & Lounge is a vibrant outdoor venue featuring an open patio with handcrafted cocktails and live entertainment. The venue hosts weekly open mic nights showcasing diverse talent including musicians, poets, and performers of all genres. Guests can enjoy food from local food trucks and experience the energetic atmosphere under the stars.

title: All Arts Open Mic @ Island Vibes Fort Lauderdale
event_description: Monthly open mic and showcase welcoming all forms of art and creative expression in a welcoming kava bar atmosphere.
venue_name: Island Vibes Kava Bar Fort Lauderdale
venue_address: 1027 North Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304
event_venue_information:
Island Vibes Kava Bar

Island Vibes Kava Bar is a vibrant community space built on music, art and good vibes. The venue hosts monthly all-arts open mic events featuring musicians, poets, and performers. With free parking, a chill atmosphere, creative drink options, and a permanent vegan food truck, Island Vibes creates an inclusive space for all music lovers.

title: Wednesday All Arts Open Mic @ Kelly Brothers Irish Pub
event_description: All-arts open mic where musicians, poets, comedians and performers showcase their talent. Signup at 7:00 PM with show starting at 7:30 PM.
venue_address: 3045 North Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33306
event_venue_information:
Kelly Brothers Irish Pub

Fully renovated Irish pub established in 1958 featuring live music at least 3 nights per week, comedy, open mic nights, karaoke and more. The venue includes a brand new New Orleans style balcony and an upstairs lounge with pool and ping-pong tables. Kelly Brothers supports local musicians and artists with a friendly, attentive staff and welcoming atmosphere.
